answer_1.quote: We leverage LLMs to generate realistic session content, synthesize corresponding facial cues, and apply rigorous filtering to ensure quality and safety.
answer_1.outputs: multimodal counseling dialogues and emotional captions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the AI therapist using GPT-4O to evaluate WAI and COUNSELINGEVAL frameworks.

answer_3.quote: Our primary evaluation relied on counseling sessions between a GPT-based client and AI therapists trained on the MIRROR dataset. These conversations were evaluated using GPT-4o within two frameworks: COUNSELINGEVAL (for general and CBT-specific skills) and a WAI-based framework for therapeutic alliance.

answer_4.quote: Specifically, two domain experts evaluated the models and selected the better model in each comparison.
answer_4.guideline: evaluated the models and selected the better model in each comparison based on therapeutic alliance dimensions
